patch_description: Insert a mid-circuit shared RZ correction layer targeting qubits 0, 4, and 8 (the high-degree qubits that participate in all three-qubit interactions). This single-parameter phase tweak is placed after Layer 3 (two-qubit entanglement) and before Layer 4 (three-qubit interactions), allowing it to refine the entanglement structure without significantly increasing parameter count or circuit depth. This approach builds on the success of shared phase parameters observed in prior programs and provides targeted correction for the most connected qubits.
